findings.evidence: Re-read consistency_tiebreak_batch 272-280: signal_kind is stored on findings only; ratings stay severity/note by schema. demote_tone_plot_holes reads finding.signal_kind and updates rating severity/note. prioritize_findings/report JSON keep signal_kind on findings — classification is not lost.
findings.message: ghostreader/typesafe/enrich.py:222 — Signal kind omission in ratings. Who is hurt: synthesis consumers reading dimension ratings. Failure: consistency_tiebreak_batch attaches signal_kind to findings but omits it from ratings, causing downstream synthesis to lose the classification.

findings.evidence: Re-read apply_repetition_evidence_policy: _update_rating runs on enrich-success (334-342), detector fallback (357-361), and demote (373). prose_analyst 282-293 passes ratings and assigns ratings_out. Notes stay synced with rewritten summaries on the typesafe path.
findings.message: ghostreader/agents/prose_analyst.py:282 — Rating notes desynchronization. Who is hurt: downstream consumers of ratings notes. Failure: ratings notes retain stale descriptions from before apply_repetition_evidence_policy while findings hold rewritten summaries.

findings.evidence: Re-read scene path 499-506: demote_* update finding severities without ratings=; AgentOutput has no ratings blob. Typesafe path 406-417 does pass ratings. Synthesis LLM path formats demoted findings; no stale rating severity left in product output.
findings.message: ghostreader/agents/consistency_checker.py:392 — Lost ratings side effects. Who is hurt: report consumers reading severity. Failure: scene_consistency_checker_node omits ratings in demote_ungrounded_concerns and demote_tone_plot_holes, leaving original un-demoted severities in output.

findings.evidence: Re-read fact_extractor.py:170-191 — _is_empty_fact_payload has one docstring only; line 187 is _parse_fact_response's real docstring. No discarded bare triple-quoted expression exists at the cited site.
findings.message: Dead string literal in `_is_empty_fact_payload`: Python only treats the first `"""..."""` after `def` as the docstring. This subsequent triple-quoted block is silently discarded as a bare expression. Convert it to a `#` comment or merge it into the docstring.

findings.evidence: Re-read demote_tone_plot_holes 414-423: last write to ratings[PLOT_HOLES_DIM]['note'] is real, but ratings are one slot per dimension by contract and each finding keeps its own summary. Typesafe path normally emits one plot_holes finding, so production harm is negligible.
findings.message: ghostreader/typesafe/grounding.py:428 — State overwrite defect. Who is hurt: Downstream consumers of dimension ratings. Failure: Multiple demoted plot hole findings overwrite ratings[PLOT_HOLES_DIM]['note'], discarding previous findings' notes and attributing the rating solely to the last item.
